newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar to close early Friday.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar to close early Friday.

text.p: White sugar trading on the London International Financial Futures Exchange (LIFFE) will end 90 minutes earlier on Friday due to the Independence Day holiday closure of New York markets.
Sugar trading on the electronic screen-based system normally continues until 18.30 local time in order to stay open until the close of the New York market.
But with New York closed on Friday LIFFE sugar will cease trading at 1700 local, an Exchange spokesperson said.
